## Smart Storage in Motion

[Contact Us](https://www.siliconmotion.com/support/contact/sales)


Join Silicon Motion's Senior Vice Presidents Alex Chou and Nelson Duann as they present "Smart Storage in Motion: From Silicon Innovation to AI Transformation Across All Spectrum" at FMS 2025 — an in-depth look at how Silicon Motion is redefining storage innovation across every AI domain, from data centers to the intelligent edge.


Discover how next-generation storage architectures and controller technologies are powering the future of AI — from high-capacity PCIe Gen6 enterprise SSDs and DPU-based storage servers to ultra-efficient client and automotive solutions that enable AI PCs, smartphones, wearable devices, vehicles, networking and humanoid robotics.
